page_title: Enconvo — The assistant your Mac was promised.

sources.entry: Enconvo - AI agent that understands your screen and completes tasks across apps.

summary.name: Enconvo
summary.one_liner: Enconvo is a native macOS AI agent that sees your screen, works inside your Mac apps, and completes multi-step tasks.
use_cases: Fix or rewrite selected text in any app
Dictate text into any app by voice
Chat with documents and notes in a knowledge base
Automate clicks and forms in Mac apps and the browser
Run AI models fully offline with local models
summary.what_it_does: Enconvo is a native macOS AI assistant and agent that works beside your apps and uses screen and selected-text context. It offers 100+ built-in AI tools for writing, search, translation and more, plus PopBar, which shows one-click actions when you select text. Agents can operate Mac apps and browsers through Computer Use and Browser Use. It supports many AI providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and local models via MLX, Ollama and LM Studio), and can be extended with MCP servers, plugins, skills and visual workflows.
notable: Native macOS app (not Electron) with PopBar selected-text toolbar
Bring your own API keys or local models with unlimited AI usage on every tier
Extensions are open source on GitHub; 80+ plugins
Pixel-art desktop pet that tracks agent status; IM bot control via Telegram, Discord, Slack, Lark
caveats: Requires macOS 14 or later; Intel and Apple Silicon supported
Free tier limits meeting recording, live captions, Live Talk, knowledge bases, workflows, scheduled tasks and IM bots; remote phone use and sync need a paid plan
Paid licenses range from $49 one-time to $139 for teams; Cloud plans from $10/month, and the core app itself is not open source
iPhone and Android apps are in beta
